5.0.SP2.description: Indicates the method of execution reporting requested by issuer of the order.

values.0: Report by mulitleg security only (do not report legs)
values.1: Report by multileg security and by instrument legs belonging to the multileg security
values.2: Report by instrument legs belonging to the multileg security only (do not report status of multileg security)
